notes: csrf-ssrf-review --full with OWASP A01/A10. Zero open findings. Refutations listed so the HTML proves the lens ran.

findings.title: Cookie mutations gated by signed CSRF vs session hash
findings.description: Candidate: session cookie fx_at SameSite=Lax on POST/PATCH/DELETE. Guard: verifyCSRF compares X-Foldex-CSRF to session.csrf_token_hash (not cookie==header). CORS wildcard rewritten to localhost. JSON-only bodies with DisallowUnknownFields. Tests TestCSRF_UnsafeVerbsRequireTheHeader and TestCSRF_MatchingHeaderAndCookieIsNotEnough.
findings.refuted_reason: Signed double-submit on the real Authenticate and Optional paths; naive cookie tossing fails against the stored hash.
findings.evidence: Signed double-submit on the real Authenticate and Optional paths; naive cookie tossing fails against the stored hash.
findings.impact: Candidate: session cookie fx_at SameSite=Lax on POST/PATCH/DELETE. Guard: verifyCSRF compares X-Foldex-CSRF to session.csrf_token_hash (not cookie==header). CORS wildcard rewritten to localhost. JSON-only bodies with DisallowUnknownFields.
findings.refuted_by: Signed double-submit on the real Authenticate and Optional paths; naive cookie tossing fails against the stored hash.

findings.title: Login CSRF via form or text/plain
findings.description: POST /api/auth/login is unauthenticated. HTML form cannot emit exact JSON; DecodeJSON DisallowUnknownFields rejects extra keys; CORS allowlist blocks credentialed application/json from foreign origins.
findings.refuted_reason: No simple-content-type path that both parses credentials and Set-Cookies a SameSite=Lax session from a cross-site top-level POST.
findings.evidence: No simple-content-type path that both parses credentials and Set-Cookies a SameSite=Lax session from a cross-site top-level POST.
findings.impact: POST /api/auth/login is unauthenticated. HTML form cannot emit exact JSON; DecodeJSON DisallowUnknownFields rejects extra keys; CORS allowlist blocks credentialed application/json from foreign origins.
findings.refuted_by: No simple-content-type path that both parses credentials and Set-Cookies a SameSite=Lax session from a cross-site top-level POST.

findings.title: POST /logout without CSRF middleware
findings.description: Logout is not behind Authenticate so verifyCSRF never runs. fx_at is explicit SameSite=Lax — not sent on cross-site POST.
findings.refuted_reason: SameSite=Lax explicit (not defaulted) withholds the access cookie from cross-site POST.
findings.evidence: SameSite=Lax explicit (not defaulted) withholds the access cookie from cross-site POST.
findings.impact: Logout is not behind Authenticate so verifyCSRF never runs. fx_at is explicit SameSite=Lax — not sent on cross-site POST.
findings.refuted_by: SameSite=Lax explicit (not defaulted) withholds the access cookie from cross-site POST.

findings.title: GET /go click-log as GET mutation
findings.description: GET /go/{slug} increments click_count. SameSite=Lax sends cookies on top-level GET.
findings.refuted_reason: The mutation is the product of following the short URL. Attacker forcing a visit equals sharing the link; no identity or ACL change.
findings.evidence: The mutation is the product of following the short URL. Attacker forcing a visit equals sharing the link; no identity or ACL change.
findings.impact: GET /go/{slug} increments click_count. SameSite=Lax sends cookies on top-level GET.
findings.refuted_by: The mutation is the product of following the short URL. Attacker forcing a visit equals sharing the link; no identity or ACL change.

findings.title: Preview/screenshot/oEmbed user URL fetch (SSRF)
findings.description: User-controlled link URLs reach Fetcher, oEmbed, screenshot Chromium proxy. Guard: safeDialer resolves then refuses IMDS/link-local/RFC1918/CGNAT, post-dial peer check, CheckRedirect revalidates hops. netpolicy + privatenet. Tests block 169.254.169.254 even when permissive.
findings.refuted_reason: Dial is pinned to resolved IPs with IMDS always blocked; Chromium capture uses strictDialContext. No unguarded http.Get(userURL) in production.
findings.evidence: Dial is pinned to resolved IPs with IMDS always blocked; Chromium capture uses strictDialContext. No unguarded http.Get(userURL) in production.
findings.impact: User-controlled link URLs reach Fetcher, oEmbed, screenshot Chromium proxy. Guard: safeDialer resolves then refuses IMDS/link-local/RFC1918/CGNAT, post-dial peer check, CheckRedirect revalidates hops. netpolicy + privatenet. Tests block 169
findings.refuted_by: Dial is pinned to resolved IPs with IMDS always blocked; Chromium capture uses strictDialContext. No unguarded http.Get(userURL) in production.

findings.title: OAuth Google HTTP client (SSRF)
findings.refuted_reason: Endpoints are Google constants from config, not request input. Operator-settable token URL is explicitly rejected in comments as credential exfiltration.
findings.evidence: Endpoints are Google constants from config, not request input. Operator-settable token URL is explicitly rejected in comments as credential exfiltration.
